info.name: Workstream Public Applicants Employee Documents API

params.name: document_id
params.description: The document id to download the file.

params.name: token
params.description: The authorization token to access the document.

items.docs:
Download employee document with document id.
**Note:** This endpoint requires the `document-public-api` feature flag. Please contact our [support team](https://help.workstream.us/en/) to request access.

params.name: employee_uuid
params.description: Returns employee docs with the input `employee_uuid`.

params.name: first_name
params.description: Returns employee docs with the input `first_name`.

params.name: last_name
params.description: Returns employee docs with the input `last_name`.

params.name: onboarding_status
params.description: Returns employee docs with the input `onboarding_status`.

params.name: start_date.gte
params.description: Returns employee docs with `start_date` after or equals to the input date.

params.name: start_date.lte
params.description: Returns employee docs with `start_date` before or equals to the input date.

params.name: hired_date.gte
params.description: Returns employee docs with `hired_date` after or equals to the input date.

params.name: hired_date.lte
params.description: Returns employee docs with `hired_date` before or equals to the input date.

params.name: applied_date.gte
params.description: Returns employee docs with `applied_date` after or equals to the input date.

params.name: applied_date.lte
params.description: Returns employee docs with `applied_date` before or equals to the input date.

params.name: onboard_date.gte
params.description: Returns employee docs with `onboard_date` after or equals to the input date.

params.name: onboard_date.lte
params.description: Returns employee docs with `onboard_date` before or equals to the input date.

params.name: embed
params.description: Specifies the names of document types that should be embedded in the response. Resources to embed must have parentheses and be comma-separated.

items.docs:
Lists existing employee documents with the input parameters.
**Note:** This endpoint requires the `document-public-api` feature flag. Please contact our [support team](https://help.workstream.us/en/) to request access.
